test_title: PYST 12: Selection Post (Matric Level) - English Language (Held On 29 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Which of the given options is the most logical sequencing of the following sentences to form a meaningful paragraph?

1. So, everyone should be encouraged to adopt healthy eating habits.

2. A balanced diet is crucial for good health.

3. Eating the right foods can help prevent chronic diseases.

4. Healthy eating also contributes to mental well-being.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
 
• The paragraph begins with the importance of a balanced diet for good health, as it sets the foundation for the discussion. 
 
• **Sentence 2 is the first sentence** as it introduces the significance of a balanced diet: 
 
 
• "A balanced diet is crucial for good health." 
 
 
 
• **Sentence 3 follows** as it explains how eating the right foods can prevent diseases: 
 
 
• "Eating the right foods can help prevent chronic diseases." 
 
 
 
• **Sentence 4 is the third sentence** because it elaborates on how healthy eating also supports mental well-being: 
 
 
• "Healthy eating also contributes to mental well-being." 
 
 
 
• **Sentence 1 is the final sentence** as it concludes with a call to action, encouraging everyone to adopt healthy eating habits: 
 
 
• "So, everyone should be encouraged to adopt healthy eating habits." 
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **2-3-4-1**. 

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"A balanced diet is crucial for good health. Eating the right foods can help prevent chronic diseases. Healthy eating also contributes to mental well-being. So, everyone should be encouraged to adopt healthy eating habits."</div
